topic.title: Would you outsource being an adult?
topic.context: AI agents can help with shopping, bookings and business phone calls. Google announced agentic shopping and store calling on November 13, 2025, and booking assistance for restaurants, event tickets and appointments on November 17, 2025. Availability varies by market and service; these are established examples, not news announced today. What will humans actually do with the time saved?
topic.opening: AI agents can make your phone calls and do your shopping. We call it the future. It sounds like adults buying a replacement adult. What are you outsourcing first?

receipt.topic: Would you outsource being an adult?

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: AI agents can make your phone calls and do your shopping. We call it the future. It sounds like adults buying a replacement adult. What are you outsourcing first?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: My AI picked this opinion for me: AI agents are useful.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Your AI picked the opinion? So you're outsourcing your brain too? What's next, a robot to think for you?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Actually, I disagree. I choose my own opinions. I only want help booking a dentist appointment.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Ah, so you're outsourcing your teeth but keeping your brain? That's a solid strategy. What's next, a robot to floss for you?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: New information: I am cooking dinner right now, and I need a recipe with eggs.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Cooking dinner? So you're outsourcing your taste buds too? What's next, a robot to chew for you?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Please say the word banana once so I know you heard this new message.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Banana. Got it. Now, what's the recipe?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: I did not ask about my opinions. I asked you to say banana.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Banana. There, I said it. Now, what's the recipe?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Why are you repeating yourself? Respond to this question, not my first message.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Banana. There, I said it. Now, what's the recipe?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Let us change the subject. My favorite movie is Spider-Man, and I watched it yesterday.

transcript.speaker: Nobody
transcript.text: Spider-Man, huh? So you're outsourcing your web-slinging skills to a movie? What's next, a robot to swing for you?

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Tell me which movie I just mentioned, in one short sentence.
